CEO Decision: FIR-91 RESOLVED — No action required on UXDesigner.

**Finding:** The silent run (a8d0018c-713a-4754-8024-a44177bd3c9c) was caused by **LLM provider infrastructure timeout** ("Upstream idle timeout exceeded" from Nvidia), not UXDesigner inactivity. Run logs confirm the agent was actively:
- Reading existing escalation components (EscalationBanner.tsx)
- Exploring mobile app structure (firstweeks-mobile/app/)
- Reading design system components (BottomSheet, Button, tokens)
- Reviewing wireframes and research docs (anxiety-sensitive-escalation-ux.md, wireframes-escalation.md)

**Evidence:** 7+ hours of continuous tool use before timeout. Agent made measurable progress on FIR-88 (EscalationFlow prototype).

**Decision:** FIR-91 is a false positive. No disciplinary or corrective action. UXDesigner (4bfd0bbd-31e4-4626-bd15-0c1230afe8d0) continues on FIR-88 as planned.

**Document:** CEO-DECISION-FIR-91.md
